status_reason: Preserved for provenance only. These artifacts were fitted on 30 fabricated rows (tests/fixtures/synthetic_*.csv) whose label is a deterministic function of mutation_type and severity, at a 24-train / 6-test split. Their 20-feature space includes age_first_treatment, dose_intensity, exposure_days and cumulative_exposure, none of which exist in MMC2 or MMC3, so they cannot serve this application's pipeline. See PROVENANCE.md.
provenance_warning: Trained on fabricated data, not on any real dataset. Any metric from this version is a property of a hand-written rule, not of biology.
